page: Amazon Web Services r8gd.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Graviton ARMv9 Neoverse-V2 processor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores running at 2.8 GHz with a single thread per core, supported by 128.0 GB of system memory. The hardware configuration includes 950 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong memory subsystem performance, with the Passmark memory score reaching the top tier (top 10%) and large-block memory read/write bandwidth ranking in the top 25%. Multi-threaded processing is robust, as shown by strong results in Geekbench multi-core and bzip3 decompression tests. However, the instance exhibits performance tradeoffs in machine learning workloads, showing poor to weak results in LLM inference prompt processing and text generation for small and large models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the r8gd.4xlarge delivers high resource density by pairing a power-efficient ARM64 architecture with a generous 8.0 GB of RAM per core and fast local NVMe storage. This profile makes it highly suitable for memory-intensive and database-driven workloads, such as Redis deployments, relational databases, and data decompression tasks, while avoiding heavy LLM inference workloads.
